# FestiveKart

> Premium crackers, corporate gifts, and festive decorations for all your celebrations.

[FestiveKart](https://festivekart.in) is India's leading online marketplace for high-quality crackers, soundless sparklers, corporate gift hampers, and traditional festival decorations. We offer doorstep delivery across India with top-tier safety certifications.

## Key Sections

- [Shop Crackers & Sparklers](https://festivekart.in/) - Premium soundless, fancy sky-shots, and traditional sparklers.
- [Corporate Gifting](https://festivekart.in/) - Curated sweets and dry fruit gift hampers for business partners and employees.
- [Festive Decorations](https://festivekart.in/) - Traditional diyas, lanterns, and modern lighting systems.
- [Customer Support](https://festivekart.in/) - Order tracking, delivery guidelines, and helper contact options.
